description: Pattern-based prevention rules for MergeKingdom — Godot 4 GDScript regression detection

rules.name: Android .aar reference without file existence check
rules.message: Local .aar dependency referenced in build.gradle — verify the binary exists in the repo or use a maven dependency
rules.suggestion: Use maven dependency (e.g., implementation 'com.google.android.gms:play-services-ads:23.0.0') or commit the .aar file

rules.name: IAP stub receipts in non-test code
rules.message: Fake/stub receipt generated in production code — IAP will never validate real purchases
rules.suggestion: Call the platform store API (Google Play Billing / App Store StoreKit) for real receipt validation

rules.name: Building removal without symmetric state reversal
rules.message: Building removal adds to idle_earning_rate without corresponding subtraction — infinite money exploit
rules.suggestion: In remove_building(): subtract building.earning_rate from idle_earning_rate before freeing the node

rules.name: Economy cost without reachability check
rules.message: Economy cost set without verifying reachability — players may not be able to afford progression items
rules.suggestion: Add an economy balance test: cost <= (starting_balance + max_earnable_before_gate)

rules.name: Scene references missing asset files
rules.message: Scene references .webp asset — verify file exists in project at build time
rules.suggestion: Add CI step to verify all res:// paths in .tscn files exist on disk

rules.name: Hardcoded economy values without constants
rules.message: Hardcoded economy value — should be a named constant or @export for easy balancing
rules.suggestion: Extract to const GEM_COST_ZONE_2: int = 1000 or @export var for designer tuning
